claim: The pre-registered moderation prediction of H-000500 is FALSIFIED. The interaction of digital-payment activity with LOWER 2019 credit-information coverage (anydigpayment x lowcov2019_z) is NEGATIVE and significant (b3 = -0.01975): the within-economy digital-payment / formal-borrowing association is SMALLER, not larger, where 2019 credit-bureau/registry coverage was lower. Robust to every pre-registered robustness branch and every Stage-3 adversarial attack with that sign.
method: survey-weighted LPM with economy fixed effects; anydigpayment + anydigpayment x lowcov2019_z + account_fin + account_fin x lowcov2019_z + primary controls
sample: 100,560 adults in 97 economies (2024 Global Findex); lowcov2019_z = one value per economy (2019 Doing Business max(bureau,registry) coverage, negative z-score)
statistical_test: economy-clustered CR1 SE; wild-cluster bootstrap; M2b below-median contrast; M6.1/6.3/6.4/6.5/6.6/6.8/6.10; 7 leave-one-region-out; 97 leave-one-economy-out; sign-reversal algebra check
result: b3 = -0.01974818 ; economy-clustered SE = 0.00474298 ; p = 6.84e-5 ; 95% CI [-0.02916, -0.01033] ; wild-cluster-bootstrap p = 0.001 ; M2b b3 = -0.03958 (p = 9.3e-5) ; leave-one-economy-out range [-0.02164, -0.01737] all negative (97/97) ; logit interaction AME = -0.0135, probit -0.0136 ; hypothesised sign was POSITIVE

verifications.detail: Independent cold-context re-implementation: M2 b3 reproduces to abs delta 3.4e-14; M2b, all M6 branches, all 7 leave-one-region-out, all 7 drop-one-control, account-holders-only, drop-zero-coverage, drop-lowest-quartile and sign-reversal all reproduce to abs delta < 1.5e-13; 97-fit leave-one-economy-out all negative. Non-material differences: M2c Wald statistic form (all variants reject H0); M6.2 non-linear AME magnitude ~11% (same negative sign).

verdict_notes.identification_credibility: The moderator is a non-random 2019 country characteristic five years before the outcome; economy fixed effects absorb its main effect but do not make the cross-level interaction causal. As a DESCRIPTIVE heterogeneity finding and as a falsification of the pre-registered prediction it is credible; the 5-year vintage mismatch and possible moderator misclassification are disclosed limitations.
verdict_notes.substantive_interpretation: GROUNDED: reported as 'the pre-registered prediction is rejected; the interaction is negative and robust', with no relabelling of the reverse pattern as confirmation and no mechanism claim (C3 and the informal-borrow placebo C4 both fail).
